## History

Hammond lived in a clearing among stumps where he worked at a small sawmill, and he and his wife raised eight children. After his death, his wife divided her children among relatives and sent [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who had been taken in by the family to help care for the children, to the orphan asylum. Hammond's children had often suffered from croup, providing [Anne](../character/anne.md) with practical medical experience that she later used to save the life of [Diana](../character/diana.md) Barry's younger sister.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V.
